description: scripts/security/semgrep-requirements.txt is hash-pinned and NOT managed by Renovate (ignorePaths); SEMGREP_VERSION in security.yml is not tracked either (the install uses that file): bump both by hand, regenerating it with pip-compile --generate-hashes (pip-tools) on a requirements.in containing only semgrep==<version>, then review the diff.

security.yml tool versions are bumped for gitleaks and osv-scanner by the customManagers below, which only change the version: update GITLEAKS_SHA256 / OSV_SHA256 in the same PR from the release checksums before merging.

Gradle Renovate PRs are expected to fail CI with 'Dependency verification failed' until gradle/verification-metadata.xml is regenerated on the Renovate branch with a cold cache; apply the diff rule in CLAUDE.md (Gradle section) before merging.

customManagers.description: gitleaks version in security.yml (GITLEAKS_SHA256 to update by hand with it)
osv-scanner version in security.yml (OSV_SHA256 to update by hand with it)

packageRules.description: android-all-instrumented is the jar Robolectric itself picks for its sdk: bumped by hand with robolectric (see libs.versions.toml), never alone
GitHub Actions: one PR per action, never grouped with libraries (each pin is reviewed on its own)
Batch non-major library updates into one PR to keep the noise down (scanner versions excluded: their sha256 is bumped by hand)
AGP / Kotlin / KSP move together and need care — keep them separate
